display.purpose: Page titles only; one per screen.

body.purpose: Default text, movement names, list content.

label.purpose: Chips, buttons, secondary rows. Machine-label variant: 12px / 700 / uppercase status tags only.

shadows.name: field-cue
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system. Sits on inputs and outline buttons as a tactile cue that the element receives input; never an ambient glow.

motion.name: fill-alpha
motion.purpose: Hover/active fill shifts (primary 90%, secondary 80%). Alpha fades, never layout or transforms.

motion.name: stroke-shift
motion.purpose: Input border color shift to ring on focus.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one decisive action surface per view — Anodized Black (Warm Ivory in dark), 6px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--color-primary, #171717); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, #FAFAFA); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(23, 23, 23, 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: rgba(23, 23, 23, 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #FFFFFF, 0 0 0 4px var(--color-ring, #D4D4D4); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary, #FFF5F5); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, #171717); } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:active { background: rgba(255, 245, 245, 0.9); } }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary choice: 1px Burr Line stroke, transparent ground, fill shifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground, #0A0A0A); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #E5E5E5); border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-accent, #F7F7F7); color: var(--color-accent-foreground, #343434); } .ds-btn-outline:active { background: var(--color-accent, #F7F7F7); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #FFFFFF, 0 0 0 4px var(--color-ring, #D4D4D4); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-btn-outline { border-color: var(--color-border, #2E2E2E); color: var(--color-foreground, #FAFAFA); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-accent, #262626); color: var(--color-accent-foreground, #FAFAFA); } }

components.name: Filter Chip (selected / unselected)
components.description: Full-radius filter pills. Selected = the solid primary surface; unselected = hairline outline that fills on hover.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 12px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #E5E5E5); border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground, #0A0A0A); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--color-accent, #F7F7F7); } .ds-chip-selected { background: var(--color-primary, #171717); border-color: var(--color-primary, #171717); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, #FAFAFA); } .ds-chip-selected:hover { background: var(--color-primary, #171717); opacity: 0.9; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-chip { border-color: var(--color-border, #2E2E2E); color: var(--color-foreground, #FAFAFA); } .ds-chip-selected { background: var(--color-primary, #FFF5F5); border-color: var(--color-primary, #FFF5F5); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, #171717); } }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Catalog search: recessed control — 12px radius, card fill, no stroke. The resting field variant carries the Field Cue shadow.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--color-card, #FFFFFF); border: none; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: box-shadow 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input-wrap:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-ring, #D4D4D4); } .ds-input-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #737373); flex: none; } .ds-input { flex: 1; height: 100%; border: none; outline: none; background: transparent; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-foreground, #0A0A0A); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #737373); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-input-wrap { background: var(--color-card, #171717); box-shadow: none; } .ds-input { color: var(--color-foreground, #FAFAFA); } }

components.name: Catalog Row
components.description: The ledger's atomic unit: a borderless 12px-radius plate with movement name, quiet muscle-group tag, and optional machine label.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; background: var(--color-card, #FFFFFF); border-radius: 12px; } .ds-row-name { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; color: var(--color-foreground, #0A0A0A); } .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 9999px; color: var(--color-foreground, #0A0A0A); background: transparent; } .ds-row-status { margin-left: auto; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #737373); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-row { background: var(--color-card, #171717); } .ds-row-name { color: var(--color-foreground, #FAFAFA); } .ds-tag { color: var(--color-foreground, #FAFAFA); } }

components.name: Floating Nav Pill
components.description: Web chrome: a floating full-radius pill with the brand pinned left and an active-tab plate inside. (Currently built from legacy Colors constants.)
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; max-width: 800px; width: 100%; padding: 8px 32px; background: #F0F0F3; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-nav-brand { margin-right: auto; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #0A0A0A; } .ds-nav-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 16px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; border: none; border-radius: 24px; background: transparent; color: #60646C; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 120ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-tab:hover { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-nav-tab-active { background: #E0E1E6; color: #0A0A0A; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-nav { background: #212225; } .ds-nav-brand { color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-nav-tab { color: #B0B4BA; } .ds-nav-tab-active { background: #2E3135; color: #FFFFFF; } }

narrative.overview:
Crowbar is a professional instrument for recording training, not a fitness app that wants to be liked. The interface behaves like a good training ledger: dense, legible, monotone, and completely uninterested in decoration. Every screen is a column of facts — movements, sets, landmarks — and the chrome around those facts exists only to keep them scannable at a glance between sets.

The material language is machined metal and paper. Warm neutrals run from Bare Steel white to Anodized Black; the only decisive surface is the near-black (or warm ivory, in dark mode) action color, which appears exactly when something is selected or about to be committed. Radii are kept to a three-step ladder, spacing to a 4px scale, and depth is conveyed by tonal layering alone — the system contains one faint functional shadow and uses it only on interactive fields.

Dark mode is a first-class citizen, shipped from the same role tokens (primary, card, muted…) rather than a sepia re-tint. The palette flips into a warm dark: ivory action surfaces on an anodized near-black ground.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome warm neutrals; single decisive action color that inverts between modes
Flat-by-default surfaces; depth through tonal layering, not shadows
System typography only — SF Pro / Roboto; no downloaded fonts
Three-step radius ladder (6px controls / 12px containers / full pills)
4px spacing scale, 16px gutters, max content width 800px
Machine-label typography (uppercase, bold, muted) reserved for status tags

rules.name: The One-Surface Rule
rules.body: The primary color (Anodized Black or Warm Ivory) appears on at most one element per view. Its rarity is the point: when the eye finds a solid dark shape, it knows that is the decision.

rules.name: The System-Font Rule
rules.body: No downloaded or custom fonts, ever. SF Pro and Roboto are the identity; a distinct typeface would make the ledger feel like a branded artifact instead of an instrument.

rules.name: The Machine-Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase bold microcopy (12px, 700) is the only sanctioned ornament. It appears solely as a status tag, muted, at the end of a row — never as body text, never in the primary color.

rules.name: The 800-Rule
rules.body: No content column ever exceeds 800px, even on wide desktop web. The ledger stays a column; whitespace goes to the sides, never inside.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: At rest, nothing casts a shadow. Elevation is earned by interactivity: fields get the Field Cue, hover and pressed states shift fill alpha (90% primary, 80% secondary), and web focus is a 2px ring — never a drop shadow.

rules.name: The No-Hybrid-Radius Rule
rules.body: A radius must be one of the three steps. 4px squares and 8–10px compromises read as a different (and softer) system; they are not in the language.

dos: Do build structure from the neutral ladder — ground, plate, mill finish — and treat the primary surface as the single decision point per view.
Do use the fixed spacing ladder (4/8/16/24/32/64px) and the 16px gutter rhythm; the ledger's calm depends on predictable rhythm.
Do keep radii on the three-step ladder: 6px controls, 12px containers, full pills.
Do support both modes from the same role tokens; a new screen must look right in Warm Ivory dark just by virtue of using card, muted, and foreground roles.
Do keep interactive elements at min-height 36px and body text at 16px — density is the product.
Do reserve uppercase bold microcopy for status machine labels like 'Archived'.
donts: Don't introduce accent hues, gradients, imagery, or emoji — the palette is steel and ivory; a second hue breaks the ledger's authority.
Don't add drop shadows or glow at rest; flat is the identity, and the Field Cue on inputs is the only sanctioned shadow.
Don't use radii outside the ladder, and never put 12px radius on a control.
Don't load custom fonts or brand the type; system faces are the identity.
Don't render more than one primary-colored element per view.
Don't uppercase body or label copy — only machine status tags.
Don't mix the legacy Colors constants into new screens; new work uses the global.css role tokens, and the legacy nav chrome is slated to migrate once its tab patterns stabilize.
